releases.notes: Checksum repair release for the Living Roads update. Replaces the rejected v1.74.6 portrait/dial extension with a syntax-checked checksum-safe build while preserving the complete v1.74.7 Living Roads, tournaments, Lucan Vale, Dominus lance, Edwyn fix, dial placement, saves and all existing content.

Living Roads major update: 45 persistent named travelers, hedge knights, squires and roadfolk now move through Solara on real routes over elapsed world time. News and Valkorion’s renown spread physically with witnesses, riders, merchants and minstrels instead of appearing everywhere at once. Adds road encounters and ledgers, the House Dominus Tourney Lance, realistic jousting gear and horse requirements, recruitable road retainers, and unique companion Lucan Vale who can earn knighthood in House Dominus with a full portrait, role and black-warhorse progression. Uses the approved cropped Aetherion portrait sheets and keeps v1.74.6 tournaments, dial placement and Edwyn fixes intact. No save reset required.

Major tournament update: annual lore celebrations and seeded random tournaments for every canonical main house, playable 8-person duel/joust/archery brackets, prizes, injuries, skill growth, reputation, morale, renown and trophies; also fixes the Quartermaster Edwyn Rook portrait leak while preserving the approved House Dominus sky-dial placement.
Moves the House Dominus sky dial into the open right-side HUD bay and replaces Quartermaster Edwyn Rook with the new full-body House Dominus special-companion portrait.
Fixes the Android top HUD and House Dominus dial placement and restores Quartermaster Edwyn Rook's unique original portrait. No APK replacement or save reset is required.

House Dominus Blood Rose sky dial. Replaces the old top-right dial artwork with the black, antique-gold, garnet, blood-rose, chalice, and nimbus design while preserving live time, celestial phases, waiting, sleep, fatigue, saves, and rollback.
